title: fix(cli): os package install reports hotLoaded: false as installed, loads at the next restart
body:
Fixes #22729

Clause-②: no

## What changes

`os package install` (`packages/cli/src/commands/package/install.ts`) printed `Package installed into the running kernel` on any `200` from `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local`, and read neither `hotLoaded` nor `hotLoadError`. Since #22695 (PR #22728, `a360cee92`), the endpoint's lenient path (a catalog manifest whose `manifest.register` throws) answers `200` with `hotLoaded: false` and the register error's message as `hotLoadError`: the package is in the runtime's ledger and loads at its next restart, while the running kernel does not hold it.

- **On `hotLoaded: false`** the command prints a warning line instead of the success line, then the same key/value block as before plus the reason:

  ```text
    ⚠ Package installed, but the running kernel could not load it — it loads at the runtime's next restart
      Package: com.acme.crm
      Version: 1.0.0
      Runtime: http://runtime.test
      Installed: 2026-10-10T00:00:00.000Z
      Hot-load error: object 'crm_account' declares field 'owner' with unknown type 'lookupx'
  ```

- **No invented reason.** When `hotLoadError` is missing, blank or not a string, no `Hot-load error:` line is printed.
- **The read is additive.** Only an explicit `hotLoaded === false` changes the output. `hotLoaded: true` (CONTROL) and an answer without the key (a runtime that predates it) print exactly as before.
- **Exit code unchanged (`0`).** The install itself succeeded: the server wrote the ledger entry and answered `200`.
- **The `storageDir` sentence is untouched.** It is still printed when the runtime states `storageDir`, on both paths.

## Premise check, against `origin/main` `a360cee92`

- **Held.** `install.ts:224` printed the success line for any 2xx and read neither key. The server half is at `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts:1373` (`hotLoaded: hotLoadError === undefined`) and `:1377` (`hotLoadError`, only beside `false`).
- **No `--json` face.** The command's flags are `runtime`, `version`, `email`, `password`, `timeout` and `confirm-global-uniques`. It does not set `enableJsonFlag`, and its only machine-readable output is its exit code. Per the dispatch, none is added here, so the triage line about the `--json` face has nothing to apply to.
- **The air-gapped file path never reaches this answer.** `os package install ./dist/objectstack.json` sends `{ manifest }` inline. install-local refuses an inline manifest whose register throws with `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED` before writing anything (`:1279`), and the command already prints that through its generic refusal branch. The new read sits after the `200` check and does not branch on mode, so both modes read the same keys.
- **No other reader.** `git grep` over `packages/cli`, `packages/client` and `packages/client-react` finds no other reader of `hotLoaded` or `hotLoadError`.

## Tests

- **New:** `packages/cli/test/package-install-hot-loaded.test.ts`, 7 cases in the `unit` tier. It stubs `fetch` the same way its siblings `package-install-storage-dir.test.ts` and `package-install-refusal-rendering.test.ts` do.
  - Lenient: `hotLoaded: false` + `hotLoadError`. No success line; the warning names "next restart"; the reason is printed verbatim; exit is unchanged.
  - CONTROL: `hotLoaded: true` prints the success line and nothing about a restart.
  - Additive: an answer without `hotLoaded` prints the success line and nothing about a restart.
  - `hotLoaded: false` with `hotLoadError` absent, `''`, whitespace or `42`: warning, no `Hot-load error` line, no `undefined`.
- **Reproduced first, from committed states.** The test was committed alone as `4a4d775f0`, on top of unchanged `main` code: `Tests 5 failed | 2 passed (7)`. The five lenient-shaped cases went red, each printing `✓ Package installed into the running kernel` over `hotLoaded: false`. The two controls stayed green. With the fix at `68df86ef6`, the same file plus both sibling install suites gave `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 15 passed (15)`.
- **Package suite at `68df86ef6`:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --project unit` gave `Test Files 2 failed | 279 passed (281)`, `Tests 4140 passed | 29 skipped`. The two failed files (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) refused because `packages/cli/dist` was absent ("packages/cli is not built"); the dependency closure had been built, the package itself had not. After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, both gave `Test Files 2 passed (2)`, `Tests 29 passed (29)`. The `integration` tier is left to CI: the diff touches no integration-tier file and no spawn entry.
- **Typecheck at `68df86ef6`:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK … 3 file(s) / 28 error(s)`, all pre-existing and ledgered). `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` lists the new test (1 hit), and none of the 28 errors are in it.

## Gates, at `68df86ef6` (this PR's head)

- **Dispatch list:** 50 lines. 46 exited 0 on the first pass. The other 4 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`) exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET, because the CLI and the rest of the workspace were not built yet. After a full `turbo run build` (`Tasks: 72 successful, 72 total`), all 4 exited 0.
- **Re-derivation** (`dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, no paths) added 15 families, and all 15 exited 0. I also ran the 4 roster gates whose roster sits under one of this diff's directories (`check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`), and all exited 0.
- **`dispatch-gates --ran`** on a record that carries each exit code: `65 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 65 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 65 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`.
- **`pnpm lint`, narrowed to the touched files, with the narrowing proven:**
  - (1) Population, read from eslint's own config: `--print-config` applies 6 active rules to `install.ts` and 5 to the new test. eslint ignores the changeset `.md` ("File ignored because no matching configuration was supplied").
  - (2) `--format json`: 3 results. The 2 linted files have 0 errors and 0 warnings. Exit 0.
  - (3) Invariance: `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting. All 8 `parserOptions` are `{ ecmaVersion: 'latest', sourceType: 'module' }`, with no `project` or `projectService`, so this diff cannot change the verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Wording follows the ruling.** The warning says the package "loads at the runtime's next restart", as triage's direction and #22728's changeset put it. The server's own `note` is more careful: "The runtime registers it again at its next restart". If the register error is deterministic (a malformed manifest), the rehydrate at the next boot can throw again. #22728's acceptance notes already record that such a rehydrate is not marked in the listing. Observation, not filed. Carrier: none.
- **Exit code.** A lenient install exits `0`. Without a `--json` face, the exit code is the command's only machine signal, so a script cannot tell a lenient install from a hot one without parsing text. Whether that should change is not decided here. Observation, not filed. Carrier: none.
- No export, error code or authorable key is added.
